instruction: Candid cinematic medium shot of an indoor party. On the left, the light-brown-haired man in a checkered shirt under a green t-shirt (R2) leans back cheering with his mouth wide open, holding a red cup. On the right, the dark-haired man in a green t-shirt (R1) stands looking down at the red cups on the table with a concentrated expression. Dim indoor lighting with blue and warm tones.
elements: R2 leans back cheering with his mouth wide open while R1 looks down with concentration
R1 focuses on the red cups on the table rather than cheering like R2
R2 holds a red cup while R1 looks at cups on the table
red cups, including one held by R2 and cups on the table
indoor party with dim blue and warm lighting
